name: How do I choose between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between custom and semi-custom cabinets involves weighing budget, design flexibility, and timeline. Custom cabinets offer limitless design possibilities, precise fit for unique spaces, and a wider range of materials and finishes, but generally come at a higher cost and longer lead time. Semi-custom options provide more flexibility than stock cabinets, allowing for some modifications to standard sizes and finishes, offering a balance between cost, speed, and personalization. Your decision often depends on your specific needs for aesthetic precision versus cost-effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets offer limitless design and fit but cost more; semi-custom provides more flexibility than stock at a moderate price. The choice depends on design precision versus budget.
